figma.description: Pull design context from Figma frames — layout, spacing, colors, components. Authenticate with your Figma Pro account (can be a different email from Claude).

github.description: Create issues (MSP-{id} format), manage PRs, and check CI for Gilmore-Tech/MyShop-mobile. Supply GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN through the host environment; never store it in this file.

filesystem.description: Read/write project files. Replace /path/to/myshop-mobile with your actual repo path.
